description: This file defines the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, representing a JSON-RPC response message used in WebSocket communications. It inherits from a base Message class and provides methods to access response ID, determine if the response is a result or error, and retrieve corresponding JSON objects.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC response message, providing methods to query response details such as ID, result, error, and validity.

methods.name: Response
methods.description: Default constructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the response message.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object if available.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object if available.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the response message is valid.
